properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency hash.js@1.1.7 (SHA-1/SHA-2 family) in bu-packages/coin-stellar/package-lock.json. Stellar SDK (js-stellar-sdk/soroban-client) depends on it. Dependency inventory: shipped in the build; no direct call sites in first-party code — used by the stellar SDK internals.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Real RC4 stream cipher use in the Counterparty (XCP) protocol data encoding inside SRC-20 minting: xcp_rc4() at line 114 RC4-encrypts the inscription data under the commit txid as key, per the Counterparty spec. RC4 here is protocol-mandated on-chain data obfuscation, not a security control; it is broken independently of quantum computing and changeable only by protocol change.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Core ECDSA signing curve of this multi-chain wallet SDK: @noble/curves secp256k1 (Aptos Secp256k1PrivateKey.sign/generate/getPublicKey), signUtil.secp256k1.sign/publicKeyCreate (Cosmos), BIP32/BIP39/Schnorr key derivation in crypto-lib. Sampled 50 of 634 sites across coin-aptos and coin-cosmos — uniformly genuine call chains for ECDSA secp256k1 signing/keygen, plus class/identifier references to the same curve. Quantum-unsafe (Shor), changeable only by ecosystem/chain migration.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 64 sites are committed TEST-FIXTURE private keys, not production secrets: bitcoinjs-lib-style WIF test vectors (cPnvkvUY..., L1vSc9..., KwTqEP...), EOS WIF test keys (5JUsJvG...), XRP test seeds (sh1HiK7..., sEdTvu...), deliberately malformed keys for negative tests (0x1234567890abcdef..., suiprivkey1invalidformat), and the public BIP340 test vector key (e8f32e72...). Standard practice for a wallet SDK's test suite; no production key material in the repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Poly1305 one-time authenticator inside the vendored tweetnacl (nacl-fast.js) and eth-sig-util's encryption.ts — the MAC half of XSalsa20-Poly1305/ChaCha20-Poly1305 used to authenticate Ethereum key material encryption. Symmetric MAC, quantum-safe; part of the NaCl authenticated-encryption stack.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: NIP-04 Nostr direct-message encryption in nostrassets.ts: secp256k1 ECDH shared secret (getSharedSecret, x-coordinate used directly as key) → WebCrypto AES-256-CBC with a fresh random IV, no MAC — malleable ciphertext. The CBC mode is what the NIP-04 protocol mandates, so code changeable here but full remediation means moving the Nostr ecosystem to NIP-44 and replacing the Shor-vulnerable secp256k1 ECDH with a PQ KEM.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Real PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 KDF at 2048 iterations — the BIP39 spec value for mnemonic-to-seed (crypto-lib/src/bip39/index.ts:82,94), where the input is an already-random 128/256-bit mnemonic rather than a low-entropy password, so the OWASP 600k password-KDF minimum is not the operative control; plus the ton-crypto primitives wrapper where the iteration count is caller-supplied (ton-mnemonic standard). BIP39's 2048 is ecosystem-fixed (all BIP39 wallets interoperate on it).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: evp_bytestokey@^1.0.3 is a declared dependency in the root lockfile — the OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey KDF (single-iteration MD5 password-to-key derivation). Weak KDF shipped in the build whether or not the application calls it directly; dependency inventory entry.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 is the dominant signature scheme across this multi-chain wallet SDK: Aptos (signUtil.ed25519 keygen/derivation/sign/verify, Ed25519PublicKey/PrivateKey, TransactionBuilderEd25519), TON, Solana, Near, and the coin-base signCommonMsg dispatch (SignType.ED25519 → signUtil.ed25519.sign). 1171 sites in 106 files, all genuine Ed25519 code (class uses, imports, key ops and verifies). properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Real classical ECDH on secp256k1, part of the tiny-secp256k1-compatible API vendored in crypto-lib/src/bip32/api.ts: ecdh() does point = pair.getPublic().mul(scalar) with optional custom hashfn (default SHA-256 of compressed point). Quantum-unsafe key agreement exposed by the project's own crypto library; 15 test sites exercise it; one lockfile entry declares the backing dependency. No first-party application call site found in this repo beyond tests — the API is exported for wallet consumers.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 key agreement via tweetnacl box, selected by the 'x25519-xsalsa20-poly1305' version string in eth-sig-util encrypt/decrypt (encrypting Ethereum key material, EIP-... MetaMask-style), exercised in eth.test.ts; plus the curve25519 Montgomery curve definition in the vendored elliptic.js (crypto-lib/src/elliptic/curves.js:143). Classical key agreement — Shor-vulnerable; migration target ML-KEM-768 / hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768. Code vendored in this repo, so changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored elliptic library API surface shipped in crypto-lib/src/elliptic/curves.js: defineCurve('p384') and defineCurve('p521') register full NIST P-384/P-521 implementations (field, order, generator, SHA-384/SHA-512 co-hash). The image ships these curves whether or not the application calls them; no first-party call site found (the wallet's own chains use secp256k1/ed25519). Changeable here (delete or trim the vendored curve registry to shrink attack surface).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-3/Keccak family in active use: SHA3-256 for Aptos account addressing and transaction hashing (sha3_256 calls in AptosWallet, v2 address utils, secp256k1 core), keccak_224/256/384/512 exports in coin-base's hash module, and keccak256 for Ethereum ABI function-selector/event hashing (abi.js, wallet-identity EIP-191 digests). All sampled sites are live digest operations or the shipped hash surface. Grover-only quantum impact; SHA3-256/keccak256 are the current standard for these chains.

BLAKE2/3 is quantum-resistant (Grover only halves preimage security). The 12 coin-

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Genuine SHA-256 use: Aptos account derivation hashing (sha256.create() in aptos_account.ts), ton-crypto primitives (node:crypto createHash('sha256') in sha256.ts:12), and 17 crypto-lib signutil test sites hashing messages with node:crypto. SHA-256 is quantum-resistant in practice (Grover gives only quadratic speedup); part of address/transaction hashing across chains.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Genuine PBKDF2 KDF throughout: @noble/hashes/pbkdf2 re-exported by coin-base and crypto-lib, BIP39 mnemonic-to-seed (c:2048, SHA-512), ton-crypto pbkdf2_sha512 wrapper (node:crypto, caller-supplied iterations), and pbkdf2@^3.x + @types/pbkdf2 npm deps in the root lockfile. Password-based KDF — migration path is memory-hard KDFs (scrypt/Argon2) rather than a PQ swap; PBKDF2 itself is not quantum-weak, only brute-force-weak for low-entropy inputs.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Real HMAC use: Stacks key derivation wires utils.hmacSha256Sync to base.hmac.create('sha256', ...) in ec.ts/keys.ts/transactions/keys.ts; BIP32 derivation uses base.hmacSHA512 (chain code, 'Bitcoin seed'); Ed25519 SLIP-0010 derivation uses hmacSHA512('ed25519 seed'); ton-crypto wraps node:crypto createHmac('sha512'); plus Stacks encryption test sites. MAC integrity layer across BIP32/SLIP-10 — HMAC-SHA-256/512 is quantum-resistant. The 6 stellar XDR schema sites were rejected as false matches.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD implemented in the vendored tweetnacl nacl-fast.js (26 sites in that one file), backing eth-sig-util's encrypt/decrypt of Ethereum key material. Symmetric AEAD, quantum-safe; the key agreement in front of it (X25519) is the quantum-vulnerable part.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared dependency @noble/ciphers@0.4.1 in the root lockfile — ships chacha20poly1305 (PQ-safe AEAD) and xchacha20. Dependency inventory: available to the shipped build; the AEAD object sites live in coin-ethereum/nacl paths.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The build's secure randomness source: Node crypto.randomBytes, backing vendored tweetnacl's randombytes (nacl-fast.js) for key/nonce generation in eth-sig-util encryption and TON's getSecureRandom primitives for mnemonic/key/IV generation. CSPRNG, quantum-safe — inventoried as the randomness primitive of record.
